Applying the ladder correctly: 'commerce-based platform is a specific way of being amazon' is FALSE — the direction is reversed. Amazon is a specific instance of commerce-based platform, so POST broadens the specific PRE instance to its encompassing category. This is Expanded (specific → category). Narrowed is rejected because subsumption does not hold in the POST→PRE direction.

youtube is a genuinely new platform addition. Nearest PRE counterparts are tiktok and instagram (other content/social platforms), but none is a defensible antecedent: YouTube is not a specific way of being any of them (Narrowed fails), shares territory but is a sibling platform not a frame-shift of one (Reframed fails), is not the same category with added detail (Elaborated fails), and is not a scope broadening of any single PRE seed (Expanded fails). Stage 1 neighborhood gate: all three PRE platforms share a 'platform for branding' territory, but a platform addition without lineage to a specific PRE platform is still a New — Expanded would require an identifiable PRE seed broadened, which youtube lacks.
